WITH event_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event AS event_id,
        SUM(spent) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS spend_ratio
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
ratios_with_average AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        spend_ratio,
        spend_ratio / NULLIF(AVG(spend_ratio) OVER (), 0) AS relative_ratio
    FROM event_ratios
)
SELECT event_id, spend_ratio, relative_ratio
FROM ratios_with_average
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
